title: Power of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: Chen Nian's prophecy came to an abrupt end. In the scroll of fate, Chapter 700, that variable that should never have appeared caused Chen Ji to feel a bone-deep chill for the first time—the chessboard of destiny seemed from the very beginning to have been quietly manipulated by another hand.

text.content: Deep within the temporal-spatial rift, golden light sliced through the darkness like blades, searing Chen Ji's vision with intense pain. That calling voice grew clearer, yet it was not the hoarse, aged voice of Mo Xiansheng he had been awaiting—it was a young, trembling female voice. "Brother... you've finally come." Chen Ji's heart contracted violently. How many years had it been? This voice had only appeared in midnight dreams, within that mist he could never grasp. He hastened forward toward the light, each step treading on the blade's edge of destiny, the Tianji Record Fragment in his arms burning hot, as if trembling for the reunion ahead.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian slowly turned around. A girl of sixteen or seventeen, her features gaunt to the point of translucence, wearing a plain white long dress that fluttered violently in the golden light, as if it might be scattered by the wind at any moment. Her eye sockets were deeply sunken, yet within burned a strange cluster of golden flames—that was the mark of destiny's power searing within her. "Brother, you've grown thin." A bitter smile curved her lips, her voice as light as a falling leaf, "All these years, I've been waiting for you to come find me."

text.content: Chen Ji surged forward three steps at once, then came to an abrupt halt three feet from her. He saw it—dozens of faintly visible golden threads wrapped around Chen Nian, those threads spreading like spiderwebs into the depths of the void, and her soul was being slowly drawn out, stripped away thread by thread. "Nian'er!" Chen Ji's voice turned hoarse, his throat seeming strangled by something, "Who did this to you?!" The impregnable city of calculations within his heart collapsed at this moment—he could lay schemes across the world, could manipulate human hearts, yet he could not stop this scene before him.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian gently shook her head, a flicker of compassion passing through those golden eyes: "Brother, this was my own choice." She raised her hand, a soft halo of light凝聚ing at her fingertips, "The Holy Sect gave me this—" she paused, as if searching for the right words, "—Power of Destiny. I can see a person's trajectory of fate, even just fleeting glimpses. The price is..." She lowered her gaze to her half-transparent hands, "Every time I use it, a part of my soul is stripped away. But I don't regret it."

text.content: Chen Ji's blood surged through his veins, the Tianji Record Fragment in his arms trembling violently, as if sensing its master's boundless fury. He stared fixedly at those golden threads, his mind racing: The Holy Sect's 'Lock Key of Heavenly Fate'—so this was its meaning! They weren't sealing Chen Nian, but using her as a vessel, raising a tool capable of peering into heavenly secrets! "How many times have you used it?" He lowered his voice, his tone terrifyingly calm, yet his knuckles had turned white from clenching. Chen Nian was silent for a moment, then raised three fingers: "Three times. The Holy Sect forced me to use it. Each time was to confirm whether a certain person still had any value to exploit."

dialogue.content: "Enough." Chen Ji stepped forward, and for the first time disregarded all propriety to grasp his sister's hand—the touch was icy, as if she were not a living person, "Tell me, how do we解除 it?" Chen Nian gazed at him, and suddenly a hint of mischief rippled through her eyes, that smile so reminiscent of her childhood self when she used to play tricks on her brother: "Brother is indeed still that incomparable Chen Ji who schemes without missing a detail." She收起笑意，正色道，"The key to breaking it lies in the ancient relic that originally granted me this ability—the 'Mirror of Destiny.' The Holy Sect has hidden it in the deepest part of their forbidden grounds, called sealing, but in truth it's to monopolize this power of peeking into destiny."

choice.prompt: The truth was within reach, but every second of hesitation accelerated the dissipation of Chen Nian's soul. Facing a sister being devoured by destiny, Chen Ji had to make a choice—

choices.description: Desperately attempt to use the Tianji Record's power to temporarily stabilize Chen Nian's soul, even at the cost of a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian's soul is temporarily stabilized, but Chen Ji falls into weakness
choices.risk_hint: Forcibly interfering with destiny may attract the attention of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao
choices.process_label: 燃烧天命换妹妹片刻安宁

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate for a moment. The Tianji Record Fragment unfolded at his command, golden text flowing like streams, weaving into a delicate net in the void. He bit through his tongue and sprayed a mouthful of heart's blood onto the fragment—agony tore through him like ten thousand arrows piercing his heart, yet he didn't even furrow his brow. "Brother, don't!" Chen Nian cried out, but could only watch helplessly as that net of destiny severed the golden threads wrapped around her one by one. The price was Chen Ji's features aging visibly by ten years.

dialogue.content: "Silly girl." Chen Ji wiped away the blood from the corner of his mouth, his smile tender yet weary, "What's this price compared to you?" However, before his words even finished, an eerie snicker echoed from the depths of the void—that sound was everywhere yet traceable nowhere, as if the entire heavens and earth were laughing mockingly. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply: The aura of the Tianji Record had been exposed.

choices.description: Calmly analyze the situation, prioritize obtaining the 'Mirror of Destiny' to fundamentally remove the shackles
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian must endure several more days of suffering
choices.visible_reward: Obtain location information of the relic, formulate a thorough plan
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian's soul might not survive
choices.process_label: 以理性之名行冒险之实

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. He released Chen Nian's hand and stepped back, his gaze regaining its former sharpness like a blade. "Nian'er, tell me the exact location of the 'Mirror of Destiny,' guard configuration, and the Holy Sect's patrol patterns." His voice recovered its usual steadiness, "Since we're going to act, we must be flawless. I won't make you suffer much longer." Chen Nian gazed at him in a daze, her eyes slightly reddened—this was the brother she knew, even if the heavens fell, he would still calculate the trajectory of every star.

dialogue.content: "The Holy Sect's forbidden grounds lie beneath the Northern Realm's abyss, and the 'Mirror of Destiny' is sealed on the seventh level—the Hall of Ten Thousand Souls." Chen Nian's voice was clear and certain, "There are only three guards, but all are old monsters of the Great Ascension stage. However..." she suddenly paused, her slender finger pointing to the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's arms, "Brother, perhaps we can borrow its power. Its aura can interfere with the Mirror of Destiny's sensing."

choices.description: This is Chen Nian's life; return the right to choose to her, and accept whatever result with composure
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian gains true free will, her bond with Chen Ji elevates to a transcendental level
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian might make an unexpected choice
choices.process_label: 尊重她的命运，也是一种放手

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell into a long silence. The golden light in the Void reflected on his face, flickering uncertainly. "Nian'er." He finally spoke, his voice low yet resolute. "This matter, only you can make the decision. Do you want me to risk everything to save you now, or wait until I obtain the 'Mirror of Destiny' to completely break your chains? Or... do you have other plans?" He stared directly into his sister's eyes, every word deliberate: "Whatever you choose, I'll support you. Even if you choose wrong, brother will clean up the mess for you."

Chen Nian was stunned. She opened her mouth but found no words coming out. How many years had it been? From the moment the Holy Sect took her away, she had been like a puppet on strings, pulled along by fate. No one had ever asked what she wanted, including herself. And now, her brother stood before her, solemnly placing the right of choice into her palm. She suddenly laughed, and as she laughed, tears streamed down her face. "I want... to show brother my power." She wiped away the tears, and an unwavering light blazed in those golden eyes. "I will let you see your fate at Chapter Seven Hundred."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart plummeted. "Nian'er, no!" He shouted in alarm, but Chen Nian had already closed her eyes. Golden light radiated around her, and those threads binding her suddenly violent vibrations, as if torn by some overwhelming force. An asphyxiating pressure permeated the air—the backlash from forcibly invoking the Law of Destiny. Chen Ji's Tianji Record Fragment shook violently at the same moment, and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emitted a sharp warning: "She is burning her soul! Stop her now!"

Chen Ji did not move. He simply stood there quietly, watching that fragile silhouette tremble within the golden light. He knew that if he interrupted now, Chen Nian would hate him for life. But if he let her continue... "Enough." He spoke softly, his tone calm to the point of being cold. "Since you want to see, let me see it with you." He opened the Tianji Record Fragment, bit his fingertip, and using blood as ink, inscribed an ancient Tianji rune on the fragment—a forbidden technique Mo Xiansheng had never taught him, the price being the instantaneous emptying of his Heavenly Fate Value.

dialogue.content: The golden light suddenly surged to its peak, then collapsed inward the next instant. Chen Nian opened her eyes, and in those golden pupils was reflected a blurred image—a man's back view, standing alone beneath a collapsing sky, beneath his feet a mountain of corpses with blood flowing like rivers. In his hand he grasped a broken longsword, on whose blade was carved an illegible name. Chen Nian's face instantly turned ashen: "This person... is brother?" Her voice trembled. "No, no—that's wrong—why are there two shadows? At Chapter Seven Hundred, there was... someone else beside brother."

choice.prompt: Who was that blurred second shadow? Chen Nian's soul was on the brink of collapse, but Chen Ji had to pursue the question—

choices.description: Risking Chen Nian's soul scattering to pieces, demanding she clearly see the identity of that shadow
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian's soul on the brink of collapse
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining key intelligence—the true identity of the second shadow
choices.risk_hint: May lead to Chen Nian's immediate death

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently. Two shadows? This meant that at Chapter Seven Hundred, the direction of fate had diverged—either him, or that unknown existence. He seized Chen Nian's shoulders, his knuckles white from force: "Nian'er, see that shadow clearly! Who is it? Su Qingyao? Ye Qing? Or..." Before he could finish, Chen Nian's body suddenly stiffened, golden threads wildly coiling around her, shredding her soul into fragments.

choices.description: Without hesitation interrupt Chen Nian's casting, prioritizing the preservation of her life
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Chen Nian's life, gaining breathing room
choices.risk_hint: That shadow may become the greatest variable in the future

text.content: Chen Ji slammed the Tianji Record Fragment against Chen Nian's chest, golden runes like chains coiling around those wildly expanding golden threads, forcibly suppressing them back. He felt his Heavenly Fate Value draining like water through a broken dam, but he didn't even blink. "Enough!" He roared, his voice carrying unprecedented panic. "I don't need any prophecy! My fate, I myself decide!" Chen Nian collapsed softly into his embrace, the golden light around her gradually fading, leaving only those half-open eyes, gazing at him blankly.

Chen Nian's breathing was as faint as a candle flame in the wind, yet she still managed to lift her hand, touching Chen Ji's face covered in cold sweat. "Brother... don't blame yourself..." Her voice was thin as a thread, every word seeming to exhaust all her strength. "That shadow... I didn't see clearly... but I remember... on him was... the aura of the Tianji Record." As her words fell, her hand listlessly dropped, and she fell into unconsciousness. Chen Ji's heart felt as if gripped by an invisible hand, tightly clenched. The aura of the Tianji Record? That meant... at Chapter Seven Hundred, another person who mastered the power of Heavenly Secrets would appear?

dialogue.content: At this moment, a gentle yet ancient force surged from the Tianji Record Fragment, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul taking the form of a phantom beside Chen Ji. He gazed at the unconscious Chen Nian, a complex expression flickering in his eyes: "What she saw... extends further than I anticipated." Chen Ji abruptly looked up, his gaze sharp as a blade: "What do you know?" Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment before slowly speaking: "The Tianji Record has nine pages, each corresponding to a destined individual. What you obtained is the third page—the page of 'Foresight'. As for the seventh page—the 'Destiny' page, it is said to have been lost a thousand years ago. But looking at the present situation..." He paused. "Perhaps it has been waiting for its true master all along."

text.content: Chen Ji carefully cradled Chen Nian in his arms, his gaze cold and sharp as ice. "So at Chapter Seven Hundred, someone will come to take my life?" Mo Xiansheng shook his head, his phantom swaying slightly in the golden light: "No, not to take your life. The meaning of the Destiny page is to rewrite fate—it will selectively overwrite the original destiny." He gazed at Chen Nian's pale profile, sighing. "What this child saw using the power of destiny is another possibility of your fate at Chapter Seven Hundred. On that path there is another you... or rather, a destiny that should have been overwritten by you." Chen Ji's pupils abruptly constricted. Another him? An overwritten destiny? The intricacies of this made a chill rise along his spine.

The spacetime rift began to tremble, the golden light gradually dimming. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul urgently said: "Time is running out, the rift is about to close. You must make a choice—take her and leave, or go alone to search for the 'Mirror of Destiny'? The two cannot be done simultaneously." Chen Ji lowered his gaze to the unconscious sister in his arms, then raised his eyes to the path leading into the unknown depths of the rift. He suddenly laughed, that smile cold and dangerous: "Who said they cannot be done simultaneously?" He tucked the Tianji Record Fragment into his chest, while the other hand supported Chen Nian's back. "After scheming across the world for so many years, could I possibly not handle one Holy Sect?"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji made his decision—how, within the limited time, to both protect Chen Nian and seize the 'Mirror of Fate'?

choices.text: Contact Ye Qing to borrow the Demonic Path's power
choices.description: Deploy the Demonic Path Saintess as a hidden trump card, using the Demonic Path's mist to conceal the Tianji Record's aura, making a feint elsewhere while striking the true target
choices.visible_reward: Gain strategic-level cover, greatly increasing the infiltration success rate
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may propose harsh conditions

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took out an ink-black jade talisman from his chest, the communication tool between him and Ye Qing. He injected a wisp of divine consciousness into it, and after a moment, elegant characters appeared on the talisman's surface: 'Northern Region Abyss, Wanhun Palace? Interesting, Sister will play with you.' Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward—Ye Qing's response was more straightforward than he had expected. This woman who had been exploited by the Holy Sect for half her life probably wanted to know the secret of the 'Mirror of Fate' more than anyone.

choices.description: Deliberately reveal Chen Nian's existence to the old sect master, using him as a chess piece to constrain the Holy Sect
choices.visible_reward: The Holy Sect descends into internal chaos, taking the opportunity to fish in troubled waters
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may turn the tables

text.content: Chen Ji sneered, taking out another jade talisman. This talisman was pure white all over, engraved with the Tianqing Sect's emblem—it was Ling Yuan's exclusive communication talisman. After careful consideration, he sent a brief message: 'Old Sect Master, your younger sister possesses extraordinary talent; the 'Mirror of Fate' seems to favor her particularly. What do you think about this?' After sending it, he crushed the talisman, letting the fragments scatter in the wind. He knew Ling Yuan's ambition all too well—where Heavenly Secrets power was concerned, this old fox would never sit by.

choices.text: Go deep into the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds alone
choices.description: Rely on the Tianji Record's Foresight Ability to infiltrate Wanhun Palace alone and seize the 'Mirror of Fate'
choices.visible_reward: Owe no one favors, completely control the situation
choices.risk_hint: The Great Ascension stage guardians are no pushovers

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gently placed Chen Nian in a hidden cave, setting up layers of formations using the Tianji Record Fragment. He leaned down and placed a kiss on his sister's forehead, whispering, 'Brother will be right back.' When he straightened up, his eyes had become cold and sharp. The mask of the废物杂役弟子废物 disciple quietly fell away, replaced by a king's face that overlooked the world. Was he really going to challenge the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds alone? Indeed, he had the capital for it—because no one present understood the direction of fate better than he did.

text.content: The spacetime rift let out rumbling thunder, the golden light growing dimmer. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul anxiously said, 'There's no time! Make one final choice—come with me, or stay?' Chen Ji did not hesitate. He picked up Chen Nian and strode toward the depths of the rift. Right before crossing into the light, he glanced back at the dark void behind him, a meaningful smile curving his lips: 'Everyone of the Holy Sect, take good care of that mirror. When I come for it next time, I hope it remains intact.' Before the words finished, the golden light completely swallowed his figure.

When the golden light dispersed, Chen Ji found himself in a barren mountain range. Chen Nian in his arms was breathing much more steadily, the golden threads wrapped around her significantly reduced—it seemed the Heavenly Fate Value formations he had woven earlier were taking effect. He looked up at the sky, a blood-red crescent moon hanging high above the clouds, the air filled with a faint scent of demonic energy. This was the edge of the Northern Region Abyss—only half a day's journey from the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds. Chen Ji placed Chen Nian in a hidden cave, leaving a strand of divine consciousness to guard her, then turned to gaze into the dark mountains ahead.

dialogue.content: He took a deep breath and took out the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest. On the yellowed pages, the characters writhed like living things, faintly glowing with golden light. Chen Ji stared at those ancient runes, then suddenly laughed softly: 'Page of Destiny? Another me?' He tucked the fragment back into his chest, his gaze becoming profound as an abyss, 'Interesting. Since both of us had the strength to fight at Chapter Seven Hundred, let me see—who rewrites fate, or who overwrites destiny.' He stepped into the dark mountains, leaving silence behind; ahead of him waited the Holy Sect's raging fury and the ultimate secret of the 'Mirror of Fate'.

text.content: However, just then, a faint tremor came from deep within the cave. Chen Ji spun around sharply to see Chen Nian, still unconscious, blazing with golden light, those golden threads that had been suppressed now frantically self-repairing. Her lips quivered slightly, producing a string of vague murmurs: 'Chapter... Seven Hundred... Don't... Brother, don't go...' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—Chen Nian's soul was clearly on the verge of collapse, yet how could she still transmit prophecy? The strangeness of it sent an unprecedented chill down his spine. The Eye of Heavenly Dao... just how big a game is it playing?

Chen Nian's eyes snapped open, those golden eyes reflecting a fragmented scene—beneath a collapsing sky, Chen Ji stood alone amid mountains of corpses and seas of blood, holding a broken sword in his hand. And in his chest, a pitch-black spear was lodged, its shaft wrapped with golden patterns identical to those on the 'Mirror of Fate'. Chen Nian's trembling voice rang out: 'Brother... Chapter Seven Hundred... You died.' She reached out, wanting to touch Chen Ji's face, but her hand weakly fell mid-air, 'It was that shadow... He killed you... and then... and then he took the Tianji Record.'
